messages:
Asha: Heads-up: Legal wants a reliable export for RBAC changes to routing policies — who changed what & when, and which rollout they were tied to.
Ben: +1. What's the minimal shape we can ship quickly?
Marisol: Proposal: ndjson incremental export. one event per line with fields: ts, change_type, resource, before, after, actor_id_hash, actor_hint, rollout_id, commit_link, export_id
Diego: PII concern: actor_id_hash ok, but include actor_hint (role/team) not email unless requested.
Asha: Also need model_variant and route_id in the payload so we can map which runtime served traffic during the change.
Ben: UX: console needs 'Export by rollout' filter + presigned link that auto-expires. Downloads should show sample count before consuming quota.
Evelyn: Quotas: admin export quota should apply. If export > 10k events require approval. add telemetry event export.requested/export.completed with size.
Marisol: Example NDJSON line:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-18T15:02:30Z","change_type":"update","resource":"routing_policy/123","before":{"route":"v1"},"after":{"route":"v2"},"actor_id_hash":"sha256:...","actor_hint":"platform+eng","rollout_id":"rollout-42","model_variant":"gptx-4o","commit_link":"https://git/repo/commit/abcd"}
```
Diego: Also record 'applied_at' vs 'requested_at' to reflect canary timing.
Asha: Ops question: who owns export retention? Legal wants 7y default, infra wants 90d hot + archive to GCS.
Ben: Let's add retention policy field in export metadata and make console show storage cost estimate before confirming.
Evelyn: I'll add telemetry events: audit.export.size_bytes, audit.export.count, audit.export.retention_selected.
Marisol: Action: Marisol + Diego to draft API shape; Asha + Ben will prototype console flow; Evelyn adds telemetry; Marisol will add PII modes.
audit-bot: export-request queued id=exp-20260318-9
Ben: Thanks — sync in eng-platform weekly if needed. :thumbsup:
